meta.title: Echoes of Distant Memory - 1
meta.description: In the name of salvation, all shall be as it was.

units.rawText: Inside the Operand Black Hole in the Enigma Sector.
units.displayText: Inside the Operand Black Hole in the Enigma Sector.

spans.text: Inside the Operand Black Hole in the Enigma Sector.

units.rawText: Hm... This is...
units.displayText: Hm... This is...

spans.text: Hm... This is...

units.rawText: Eos blinks and stares blankly as she opens her eyes, but all she sees is the usual chaotic void before her.
units.displayText: Eos blinks and stares blankly as she opens her eyes, but all she sees is the usual chaotic void before her.

spans.text: Eos blinks and stares blankly as she opens her eyes, but all she sees is the usual chaotic void before her.

units.rawText: Are you awake, Sanctifier Eos?
units.displayText: Are you awake, Sanctifier Eos?

spans.text: Are you awake, Sanctifier Eos?

units.rawText: Data coalesces into an image, and a figure appears in front of Eos.
units.displayText: Data coalesces into an image, and a figure appears in front of Eos.

spans.text: Data coalesces into an image, and a figure appears in front of Eos.

units.rawText: I thought that I'd be able to slumber again after that brief dream, but it seems life abounds with surprises as long as you're awake to see them.
units.displayText: I thought that I'd be able to slumber again after that brief dream, but it seems life abounds with surprises as long as you're awake to see them.

spans.text: I thought that I'd be able to slumber again after that brief dream, but it seems life abounds with surprises as long as you're awake to see them.

units.rawText: Are you a friend of <cmdr>? I saw you before, when you hacked into Eosphorus' fragment.
units.displayText: Are you a friend of {교수}? I saw you before, when you hacked into Eosphorus' fragment.

spans.text: Are you a friend of
? I saw you before, when you hacked into Eosphorus' fragment.

units.rawText: ...Eos, I have a question for you.
units.displayText: ...Eos, I have a question for you.

spans.text: ...Eos, I have a question for you.

units.rawText: Antonina takes a deep breath.
units.displayText: Antonina takes a deep breath.

spans.text: Antonina takes a deep breath.

units.rawText: Is <cmdr> in danger?
units.displayText: Is {교수} in danger?

spans.text: Is
in danger?

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: Antonina seems surprised by how Eos managed to discern her motivation for coming here at a glance. However, she soon calms down again.
units.displayText: Antonina seems surprised by how Eos managed to discern her motivation for coming here at a glance. However, she soon calms down again.

spans.text: Antonina seems surprised by how Eos managed to discern her motivation for coming here at a glance. However, she soon calms down again.

units.rawText: Frankly speaking, I don't know whether I should place my bets on you, considering how much is riding on it... But <cmdr> says that they trust you.
units.displayText: Frankly speaking, I don't know whether I should place my bets on you, considering how much is riding on it... But {교수} says that they trust you.

spans.text: Frankly speaking, I don't know whether I should place my bets on you, considering how much is riding on it... But
says that they trust you.

units.rawText: Unfortunately, they're still trapped in the module's memory data and can't establish a connection to this place, so I'll just have to serve as a substitute for now.
units.displayText: Unfortunately, they're still trapped in the module's memory data and can't establish a connection to this place, so I'll just have to serve as a substitute for now.

spans.text: Unfortunately, they're still trapped in the module's memory data and can't establish a connection to this place, so I'll just have to serve as a substitute for now.

units.rawText: Simply put—we need Eosphorus' Signature.
units.displayText: Simply put—we need Eosphorus' Signature.

spans.text: Simply put—we need Eosphorus' Signature.

units.rawText: I see... Indeed, Eosphorus and I are joined together because of Judgement Mode.
units.displayText: I see... Indeed, Eosphorus and I are joined together because of Judgement Mode.

spans.text: I see... Indeed, Eosphorus and I are joined together because of Judgement Mode.

units.rawText: Therefore, all you need to do is analyze me, and you will have a way to deal with the fallen Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Therefore, all you need to do is analyze me, and you will have a way to deal with the fallen Eosphorus.

spans.text: Therefore, all you need to do is analyze me, and you will have a way to deal with the fallen Eosphorus.

units.rawText: You catch on quick, Miss Eos. But we don't have much time.
units.displayText: You catch on quick, Miss Eos. But we don't have much time.

spans.text: You catch on quick, Miss Eos. But we don't have much time.

units.rawText: We also need a way to quickly pass the Signature on to the Professor after obtaining it.
units.displayText: We also need a way to quickly pass the Signature on to the Professor after obtaining it.

spans.text: We also need a way to quickly pass the Signature on to the Professor after obtaining it.

units.rawText: Antonina looks at the disintegrating virtual realm around her.
units.displayText: Antonina looks at the disintegrating virtual realm around her.

spans.text: Antonina looks at the disintegrating virtual realm around her.

units.rawText: This world is unstable; you should know that, as a native of this place.
units.displayText: This world is unstable; you should know that, as a native of this place.

spans.text: This world is unstable; you should know that, as a native of this place.

units.rawText: My Sacred Canon has not yet been tainted, so if you could send the analyzed information to the Sacred Canon in the fragment...
units.displayText: My Sacred Canon has not yet been tainted, so if you could send the analyzed information to the Sacred Canon in the fragment...

spans.text: My Sacred Canon has not yet been tainted, so if you could send the analyzed information to the Sacred Canon in the fragment...

units.rawText: Unfortunately, Eosphorus seems to have taken your Sacred Canon away.
units.displayText: Unfortunately, Eosphorus seems to have taken your Sacred Canon away.

spans.text: Unfortunately, Eosphorus seems to have taken your Sacred Canon away.

units.rawText: But how... Eosphorus, you...
units.displayText: But how... Eosphorus, you...

spans.text: But how... Eosphorus, you...

units.rawText: Eos frowns and she sighs quietly.
units.displayText: Eos frowns and she sighs quietly.

spans.text: Eos frowns and she sighs quietly.

units.rawText: But the Professor said you still had something that could help us, as an anchor point to the inside of the fragment.
units.displayText: But the Professor said you still had something that could help us, as an anchor point to the inside of the fragment.

spans.text: But the Professor said you still had something that could help us, as an anchor point to the inside of the fragment.

units.rawText: "I want to make more memories with you, too. And the chance for that is right before your eyes." ...That's what they said.
units.displayText: "I want to make more memories with you, too. And the chance for that is right before your eyes." ...That's what they said.

spans.text: "I want to make more memories with you, too. And the chance for that is right before your eyes." ...That's what they said.

units.rawText: Ah...
units.displayText: Ah...

spans.text: Ah...

units.rawText: If there's anything you want to tell me, you can say it to the Reverse Tower when you return to it.
units.displayText: If there's anything you want to tell me, you can say it to the Reverse Tower when you return to it.

spans.text: If there's anything you want to tell me, you can say it to the Reverse Tower when you return to it.

units.rawText: And if possible, I really wish I could have made more memories with you.
units.displayText: And if possible, I really wish I could have made more memories with you.

spans.text: And if possible, I really wish I could have made more memories with you.

units.rawText: You and Eosphorus will have to finish the last leg of this journey. Please do your best to help him. Do it for me, for us.
units.displayText: You and Eosphorus will have to finish the last leg of this journey. Please do your best to help him. Do it for me, for us.

spans.text: You and Eosphorus will have to finish the last leg of this journey. Please do your best to help him. Do it for me, for us.

units.rawText: <cmdr>...
Eos strokes her earring and smiles.
units.displayText: Eos strokes her earring and smiles.

spans.text: Eos strokes her earring and smiles.

units.rawText: You must be the Miss Antonina that the Professor was mumbling about earlier.
units.displayText: You must be the Miss Antonina that the Professor was mumbling about earlier.

spans.text: You must be the Miss Antonina that the Professor was mumbling about earlier.

units.rawText: I will deliver the equation for victory to <cmdr> and your friend.
